_comment: Minimum scores the suite must meet.
The gate is the typst-suite group, NOT the whole corpus. `typst/typst@v0.15.1
tests/suite` is a fixed, version-pinned set of 221 files, so its score is
reproducible on any machine. The Universe package corpus is whatever the registry
holds on the day it was fetched and how many packages were asked for, so its score
drifts — CI fetching 200 packages and a laptop fetching 600 do not produce the same
number. It is reported, but not gated.
Validity is now pinned at 1.0 in both directions: every file typst accepts we accept,
and every file it rejects we reject. That is no longer a floor to climb but a property
to defend, so any regression fails the build.
Span agreement is the one still climbing, and the floor sits just under the current
score so a real regression shows up without a red build on every run.
Ratchet these up as the numbers improve — never down to make a red build pass.
